answer: Each identity must reach a nadir of cumulative stake-weighted age before gaining consensus weight. The protocol assigns a violet badge after 12 epochs of continuous attested work, with each epoch requiring a fresh proof-of-unique-humanity signed by a vertex of rotating auditors. A sybil fleet cannot transfer this badge; each fake identity must independently pass the time-gate and audit vertex, paying the full cost per identity per epoch. The cost scales linearly with fleet size and cannot be amortized, as badges are non-transferable and decay if epochs are missed.
